items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I remember there was a band at Club Alabam by the name of Lorenzo Flaunois, the piano player

ctx.x: was a place called the Bucket of Blood, as well as the famous Club Alabam and I used to hang around with Tyree Glenn, this was during the time that he was playing with Eddie Barefield at the Cotton Club. Eddie Barefield left Cab Calloway to form a band and Tyree was in that band while I was with Charlie Echols in the City of Los Angeles at Billy Patke's Club.

And after each performance, after the night was over at our respective places where we worked, we got together out in Central Avenue and that was my first introduction to drugs, marijuana, and it was considered at the time to be in the in-crowd and I tried it. By golly, that was some years. That was the year and -- ha-ha -- I got high and sat in with most of the musicians around town there, which included Tyree, there was quite a number of guys that -- I remember there was a band at Club Alabam by the name of…
